'''Crème Ninon''' is a [[soup]] with a [[Cooking base|base]] of a heavy [[Stock (food)|stock]] [[purée]] of [[green pea]]s and dry [[Champagne (wine)|champagne]]. It is flavoured with [[lemon]] and some dry [[sherry]], as well as [[Edible salt|salt]] and [[Black pepper|pepper]]. Just before serving it is topped with some [[whipped cream]] and champagne.
